knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r libraray}
install.packages("tidyverse")
install.packages("here")
install.packages("ggplot2")
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
library("ggplot2")
```


```{r}
# Load the CSV file
witch_trials <- read_csv(here("data", "GODWIT_dataset_geocoded.csv"), na ="NULL")
```


```{r}
#Jitter plot
witch_trials_plot <- witch_trials %>% 
  mutate(
    period = floor(as.numeric(Date_of_Accusation) / 50) * 50,
    Region = case_when(
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Sjælland") ~ "Sjælland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Nørrejylland") ~ "Nørrejylland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Skånelandene|Skønelandende") ~ "Skånelandene", 
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Fyn") ~ "Fyn", 
      TRUE ~ "small islands"
    )
  )

ggplot(
  witch_trials_plot,
  aes(x = as.numeric(Date_of_Accusation), y = Region, color = Region)
) +
  geom_jitter(width = 3, height = 0.2, size = 2.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sjælland" = "#D94A4A",
      "Nørrejylland" = "#3F6FB5",
      "Skånelandene" = "#D6B83F",
      "Fyn" = "#8A5BA8",
      "small islands" = "#5A9E62"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      floor(min(as.numeric(witch_trials_plot$Date_of_Accusation), na.rm = TRUE) / 50) * 50,
      ceiling(max(as.numeric(witch_trials_plot$Date_of_Accusation), na.rm = TRUE) / 50) * 50,
      by = 50
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Witch Trials Across Time",
    subtitle = "Each point represents one recorded trial",
    x = "Year", y = "Region", color = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey35", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 15)
  )


```

```{r}
#Barplot
witch_trials_bars <- witch_trials %>% 
  mutate(
    period = floor(as.numeric(Date_of_Accusation) / 50) * 50,
    Region = case_when(
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Sjælland") ~ "Sjælland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Nørrejylland") ~ "Nørrejylland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Skånelandene|Skønelandende") ~ "Skånelandene", 
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Fyn") ~ "Fyn", 
      TRUE ~ "small islands"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  count(period, Region, name = "witch_trials")

# Make the bar plot
ggplot(
  witch_trials_bars,
  aes(x = factor(period), y = witch_trials, fill = Region)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 1),
    width = 1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sjælland" = "#D94A4A",
      "Nørrejylland" = "#3F6FB5",
      "Skånelandene" = "#D6B83F",
      "Fyn" = "#8A5BA8",
      "small islands" = "#5A9E62"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 800, by = 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Witch Trials Across Time",
    subtitle = "Number of recorded trials per 50-year period, by region",
    x = "Year", y = "Number of Witch Trials", fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey35", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 20, 15, 15)
  )


```

```{r}
# Top 10 years with the most witch trials, and their locations

top_years <- witch_trials %>% 
  mutate(
    Year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Date_of_Accusation)),
    Region = case_when(
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Sjælland") ~ "Sjælland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Nørrejylland") ~ "Nørrejylland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Skånelandene|Skønelandende") ~ "Skånelandene", 
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Fyn") ~ "Fyn", 
      TRUE ~ "small islands"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>% 
  count(Year, name = "total_trials") %>% 
  arrange(desc(total_trials)) %>% 
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(top_years)

# Region breakdown for each of those top years
top_years_by_location <- witch_trials %>% 
  mutate(
    Year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Date_of_Accusation)),
    Region = case_when(
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Sjælland") ~ "Sjælland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Nørrejylland") ~ "Nørrejylland",
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Skånelandene|Skønelandende") ~ "Skånelandene", 
      str_detect(Location_of_Case, "Fyn") ~ "Fyn", 
      TRUE ~ "small islands"
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Year), Year %in% top_years$Year) %>% 
  count(Year, Region, name = "trials") %>% 
  arrange(desc(Year), desc(trials))

print(top_years_by_location)

# --- Barplot 1: total trial counts for each of the top 10 years ---
ggplot(top_years, aes(x = reorder(factor(Year), -total_trials), y = total_trials)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3F6FB5", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Years With the Most Witch Trials",
    x = "Year", y = "Number of Witch Trials"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

# --- Barplot 2: trial counts by Region, within top 10 years, dodged ---
ggplot(top_years_by_location, aes(x = factor(Year), y = trials, fill = Region)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Sjælland" = "#D94A4A",
      "Nørrejylland" = "#3F6FB5",
      "Skånelandene" = "#D6B83F",
      "Fyn" = "#8A5BA8",
      "small islands" = "#5A9E62"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Years of Witch Trials by Region",
    x = "Year", y = "Number of Witch Trials", fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

```
